Introduction Claude Mythos Preview is a new large language model from Anthropic.
[anthropic-claude-mythos-preview-system-card] Second, we updated the grading model for CharXiv Reasoning and LAB-Bench FigQA.
[anthropic-claude-mythos-preview-system-card] While evaluating our models, we found that Claude Sonnet 4 (the previous grader) occasionally failed to emit well-formatted grading outputs—particularly when the model being evaluated produced long tool-use traces—which artificially depressed scores on LAB-Bench FigQA and CharXiv Reasoning.
[anthropic-claude-mythos-preview-system-card] 6.11.1 LAB-Bench FigQA LAB-Bench FigQA is a visual reasoning benchmark that tests whether models can correctly interpret and analyze information from complex scientific figures found in biology research papers.
[anthropic-claude-mythos-preview-system-card] The benchmark is part of Language Agent Biology Benchmark (LAB-Bench) developed by FutureHouse,26 which evaluates AI capabilities for practical scientific research tasks.
[anthropic-claude-mythos-preview-system-card] With adaptive thinking, max effort, and without tools, Claude Mythos Preview achieved a score of 79.7% on FigQA.
